entities.summary: Inna Antonivna Kolomiets was an outstanding Ukrainian sculptor, Honored Artist of Ukraine (1973), and a member of the National Union of Artists of Ukraine (1973). The creative work of Inna Kolomiets is an example of authentic national art of the twentieth century. Since the 1950s, she had a subtle influence on the vector of development of Ukrainian social realism.
